finding: Independent owned batch allocations could share one cloned reservation, or reacquire the same reservation through reserve_arc and reuse it, while logical workspace charged only once.
fix: Accept only exclusively held, non-shared-key workspace reservations for produced batches; existing retained batch clones still share the same actual owned byte allocation.
limits: Synthetic internal API counterexamples; current production JSON assembler already allocates separate reservations, so no claim that the real workflow triggered this. No complete workspace, production IPC, exhaustive concurrency or RSS qualification.
